source: s3://pax-2-638175140432/vqa/raw/qwen3-vl-4b-p3/ (scripts/vqa/vqa.py, Qwen3-VL), the uniform baseline in data/raw/vqa/set.tsv
notes: Answers are read from 13 sampled frames: 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3 s, six spread over the rest, and the last half second. Anything shown only between samples is unseen.
No identity or demographic inference: people are counted, nothing else.
Accuracy per column is the hand audit's, in data/generated/model/vqa-audit.json.

columns.captionsBurnedIn: 0/1: the spoken words appear as on-screen text that changes with the speech (a headline or title that stays put is not captions)
columns.callToAction: 0/1: the picture shows an explicit ask of the viewer (subscribe, follow, like, share, comment, donate, vote, register, sign, call, listen, watch more, visit a link, join)
columns.ctaSec: seconds: timestamp of the first sampled frame showing that ask; only where callToAction is 1
columns.format: enum: talking head | graphic card | b-roll | rally | news clip | interview | other — the dominant one
columns.setting: enum: indoor | outdoor | studio | archival | graphics only — the dominant one
columns.peopleMax: count: the most people visible in any one sampled frame, background, split screens and insets included (capped at 20); counts only, never identity or demographics
columns.peopleScreenShare: share 0-1: sampled frames with at least one person visible
columns.productShown: 0/1: a commercial product, merchandise or branded package is a subject of the video
columns.thirdPartyWatermark: 0/1: a logo, handle or watermark overlaid on the picture from another platform, outlet or creator; the channel's own branding and logos on microphones, podiums or backdrops are not

crossCheck.onScreenText: 0/1: readable text added in editing in any sampled frame — overlaps composition's OCR (textFrameShare), a cross-check, not a column
